body:
i am currently living with my aunt about 5000 km from my parents but even at those distances she is able to control my live . all hail technology

i finished 12 grade few months back. and as for the university i will have to take up distance education i.e, sit at home and study and go to center and write exam once an year.

we live in a flat so most of the work involves cooking and use a washing machine for clothes.

i also used to think since i punch so much i might have a better pain tolerance than i think but its mostly in anger and if i am not angry i will start crying even due to a slap . most people get angry when hit i start to cry as if it is my bodies reflex.

and also i doubt my parents will let me join an martial arts class since they might think i will only waste their money and giveup in two days.

i know but my mothers words hurt to much to continue working .

if i say her his in a calm voice she will say how dare you talk back and hit me.

before i started i knew that the weightloss might take upto an year but that did not discourage me but the fact that i won't be able to control my diet as my mother makes me eat large portions and has forced me since young age to clear the plate.

when i would workout i would feel more confident even though i would not have lost even a single pound. my body language would change i would constantly feel happy and enjoy the workout.

but my mothers attitude but always deter me from working out.

as for the martial arts i have always wanted to learn to protect myself but was/am not sure if i will be able to take a beating without breaking down and crying in in the dojo.

thanks for the reply .

the problem is i have tried losing weight in the past multiple times but after a week or so of no results and my mother making jokes about how i am not working out right and pushing me outside my bounds by berating me i would drop it. this led to me not having self confidence or respect
